name: Hematoma raises Bloodbolt's self-heal multiplier (#1933)
contract: Hematoma's two ranks (504758 rank 1, 504896 rank 2) carry ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), MiscValue 27 (SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER), classmask (0,131072,0) which matches exactly the 8 Bloodbolt ranks (578304, 578305, 804685, 806928-806932), no remainder. BasePoints are 19 (real +20%) on rank 1 and 39 (real +40%) on rank 2, matching the tooltip exactly. SpellEffectInfo::CalcValueMultiplier (SpellInfo.cpp) applies SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER generically; Spell.cpp consumes it as Bloodbolt's own healMultiplier for its SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH effect. spell_modifier queries this directly against a 1.0 baseline multiplier without casting or owning the target spell. 578305 (level 60) is the rank a level-80 character owns.

steps.label: No heal multiplier bonus before Hematoma
Rank 1 raises Bloodbolt's self-heal multiplier to 1.20
Rank 2 raises Bloodbolt's self-heal multiplier to 1.40
